title: AeroFootprint - WHU Aerial Building Segmentation
dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 (as declared by the Hugging Face dataset card)
training: TensorFlow/Keras four-level U-Net trained from random initialization; no pretrained weights
metric_note: Macro per-image metrics assign 1.0 to empty-ground-truth/empty-prediction tiles. Prefer micro metrics as headline results.
geospatial_limitation: PNG mirror has no per-tile geotransform; exported contours are in pixel coordinates, not latitude/longitude.
